latest_mutant.description: Fast Ethernet 100BASE-TX Start-of-Stream Delimiter detection bug: OP_WAITEDGE rising-edge mode (edge_mode 2'b01) detects falling edges instead of rising edges, causing /J/ /K/ SSD delimiter transition detection on TXP to stall indefinitely
